scenarios.title: A｜别人主动告诉自己
scenarios.setting: 午休时，同事突然压低声音。

turns.text: Have you heard what’s going on with Morgan?

turns.prompt: 你想回应同事提起的消息，了解发生了什么，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, what happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: No, what happened?
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I don’t think so. What’s going on?

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think so. What’s going on?
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I’ve heard a few things, but I don’t really know what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve heard a few things, but I don’t really know what happened.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: No. Is everything okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: No. Is everything okay?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: Apparently she had a big argument with the manager yesterday.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方提到的办公室消息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Really? What was it about?

feedback.naturalExpression: Really? What was it about?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Oh, I didn’t know that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I didn’t know that.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I noticed things seemed a little tense yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed things seemed a little tense yesterday.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: Hmm. I wonder what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hmm. I wonder what happened.
feedback.explanation: “I wonder”表示好奇或疑惑，语气比直接断言原因更开放。

turns.text: I heard it was about the new project, but I’m not sure.

turns.prompt: 关于「办公室八卦」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I guess we’ll find out eventually.

feedback.naturalExpression: I guess we’ll find out eventually.
feedback.explanation: “I guess”表示自己的推测，语气比直接断言更轻。

choices.text: Yeah, it’s probably better not to assume anything yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, it’s probably better not to assume anything yet.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Interesting. I hadn’t heard about that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Interesting. I hadn’t heard about that.
feedback.explanation: “I hadn’t”说明在过去某个时点之前尚未发生，能交代事情的先后关系。

choices.text: Well, hopefully they work it out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Well, hopefully they work it out.
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。

scenarios.title: B｜自己不想参与
scenarios.setting: 在“办公室八卦”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“自己不想参与”。

turns.text: Did you hear what happened between Jamie and Chris? Apparently—

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I actually haven’t heard, but I’d rather stay out of it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I actually haven’t heard, but I’d rather stay out of it.
feedback.explanation: “stay out of it”表示不介入这件事，适合说明不想卷入争论或八卦的立场。

choices.text: I’d rather not get involved in office gossip.**

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not get involved in office gossip.**
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Maybe we shouldn’t talk about it if we don’t know what really happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we shouldn’t talk about it if we don’t know what really happened.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Honestly, I’d rather hear it from them directly.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I’d rather hear it from them directly.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I don’t care about their things.

feedback.naturalExpression: I actually haven’t heard, but I’d rather stay out of it.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t care”容易显得冷漠；若只是想避开八卦，用“I’d rather stay out of it”能表达界限。

turns.text: Fair enough. I was just curious.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己不想卷入同事间的纠纷，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I get it. I just don’t want to get caught in the middle.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I get it. I just don’t want to get caught in the middle.
feedback.explanation: “caught in the middle”表示被夹在双方的矛盾中，描述的是为难的处境。

choices.text: No worries. I’d just rather not take sides.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. I’d just rather not take sides.
feedback.explanation: “take sides”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

choices.text: Anyway, how’s your project going?**

feedback.naturalExpression: Anyway, how’s your project going?**
feedback.explanation: “how’s”用于询问某人的近况或某件事的进展，具体对象紧接其后。

scenarios.title: C｜被问怎么看某件事
scenarios.setting: 在“办公室八卦”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“被问怎么看某件事”。

turns.text: So what do you think about the whole situation with the new team lead?

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I’m not sure yet. I don’t think I know enough about the situation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure yet. I don’t think I know enough about the situation.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: It’s hard to say. I’ve only heard one side of the story.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s hard to say. I’ve only heard one side of the story.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I have some thoughts, but I’d rather wait and see what happens.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have some thoughts, but I’d rather wait and see what happens.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Honestly, I don’t really want to take sides.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I don’t really want to take sides.
feedback.explanation: “take sides”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

choices.text: I don’t have an opinion because it’s not my business.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure yet. I don’t think I know enough about the situation.
feedback.explanation: 不参与评价是合理界限；“not my business”略显疏离，可说自己了解不够、暂不下结论。

turns.text: Come on, you must have some opinion.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己担心的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I just don’t want to judge anyone without knowing the full story.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just don’t want to judge anyone without knowing the full story.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: Maybe, but I think it’s better to stay neutral for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe, but I think it’s better to stay neutral for now.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’d rather focus on how it affects our work.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather focus on how it affects our work.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: If it starts affecting the project, then I think we should talk about it as a team.

feedback.naturalExpression: If it starts affecting the project, then I think we should talk about it as a team.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.prompt: 关于「办公室八卦」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: We’ll see how things develop.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ll see how things develop.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Hopefully everything settles down soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hopefully everything settles down soon.
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。

choices.text: Anyway, I guess we’ll know more eventually.

feedback.naturalExpression: Anyway, I guess we’ll know more eventually.
feedback.explanation: “I guess”表示自己的推测，语气比直接断言更轻。
